title.zh: Bitget’s eighth birthday ends with a $352M hack
title.en: Bitget’s eighth birthday ends with a $352M hack

current_state.zh: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen confirmed the exchange lost roughly $352 million in an attack bearing the hallmarks of North Korea's Lazarus Group, with the breach traced to its wallet services backend rather than a private key compromise and several chains freezing related addresses.
current_state.en: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen confirmed the exchange lost roughly $352 million in an attack bearing the hallmarks of North Korea's Lazarus Group, with the breach traced to its wallet services backend rather than a private key compromise and several chains freezing related addresses.
